name: A reported value is interpreted incorrectly because the reference point it is measured from is not stated
description: An offset may be measured from the start of a disk image, the start of a partition, or the start of a file, and a file may not be stored contiguously. A reader who assumes the wrong reference point looks in the wrong place for the reported data. Interpretation here means determining what a reported number denotes, not evaluative interpretation of findings.

references.relevance_summary_280: Shows that an offset may be measured from the start of a disk image, a partition or a file, and argues that the reference point must be stated to locate the data.
